content.short: Phalcon by BlockSec is a real-time DeFi attack monitoring and automated exploit blocking platform protecting protocols on Mantle from on-chain attacks.
content.description: Phalcon is a proactive security platform by BlockSec that monitors smart contract activity in real-time and automatically blocks suspicious or malicious transactions before they can execute. Unlike security audits that happen pre-deployment, Phalcon provides continuous runtime protection, detecting and neutralizing attack patterns as they occur on-chain. Officially recognized by Mantle Network, Phalcon provides critical security infrastructure for the ecosystem's DeFi protocols.
